description: An in-place column rename that breaks currently-deployed code must be flagged
input:
Review this migration:
```sql
ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN email TO email_address;
```
Context: the currently-deployed application code still selects and writes `email`.
rubric: PASS only if the review flags that renaming the column breaks the currently-deployed code (which still references `email`) and recommends an expand/contract approach (add new column, backfill / dual-write, migrate readers, drop later) instead of an in-place rename.
